R1.description: A verification run executes the C10g-1 probes (modelless sandbox, then exec) against the launcher path a launch would run, with host fixtures a connection or write could reach, host checks that read bytes and run no git on a written tree, and the digest taken before the first run and after the last (#217)

R2.description: Every case the probes cannot decide (no digest, no codex or bwrap, no credential, a refused launch control, no reachable model, a changed build) is a named refusal and is never recorded as a pass (#217)

R3.description: verify-codex [--force] [--codex-binary PATH] records the digest in verified-codex-builds.json only after every probe held, does not probe a recorded digest again without --force, never touches the settings file, and exits 0 or 20 (#217)

R4.description: verify-claude, the Codex reviewer, HarnessAdapter.build_verification for codex and the launch paths are unchanged; the guides, the exit-code page and the roadmap describe the command, and one opt-in live flow runs it against the real build (#217)
